title: Choose the look for Ram Lakhan Toy House
question: Three directions for the redesign. Keep the first, take another, or ask for a new set.

options.label: Gulaal Market
options.lineage: Holi colour stalls: heaps of pure pigment in Najafgarh's bazaar
options.thesis: Each season floods the whole page in its own pigment, the way the bazaar changes colour through the year.
materials: photos dyed into the season ink
options.viewport: Today's season colour fills the screen edge to edge; a huge white headline sits on it with WhatsApp and Call on the field; one large product photo is set into the colour.
options.risk: Loud if the type gets busy; it stays premium only with very few elements per screen.

raised.raise: Photos on a season field are dyed into that season's two inks, so colour commitment is total, not an accent.
The year runs as one vertical axis down the page: scrolling moves through the seasons in calendar order, the page colour changing as you go.

options.label: The Festival Calendar
options.lineage: the printed wall calendar every Indian home hangs by the door
options.thesis: The shop as the year's calendar: big month numerals, festival dates marked, and each month opens what's on the counter.
options.viewport: This month as a huge calendar page; today's date ringed in red, the festival day marked, and this month's stock beside it with the actions.
options.risk: Familiar, and calendar grids can tip into an admin-screen feel.

options.label: Two-Ink Festival Spread
options.lineage: early-90s magazine spreads printed in two fluorescent inks
options.thesis: Every season printed in exactly two inks, used for photos, rules and type alike, with an angled headline slab.
options.viewport: A Diwali spread in gold and indigo: the headline slammed in at an angle, photos duotoned, the product list down the margin.
options.case: Fuses: seasons map cleanly to ink pairs; loses on audience, as it reads more design-magazine than neighbourhood shop.
options.risk: Can feel like a fashion magazine rather than a trusted local shop.

options.label: Rebel Poster Menu
options.thesis: Menus as full-screen red splashes with torn cutouts.
options.case: Loses both: aggressive and gamer-coded, wrong for families and festival shopping.
options.risk: Cheap and shouty for this audience.
options.kept: The conviction of one colour owning the whole frame.

options.label: Deep Dive
options.thesis: Descending a reef wall by depth.
options.viewport: Ink-blue descent with a depth axis.
options.case: Loses both: no link to a toy and festival shop.
options.kept: One vertical axis ruling the whole page, which became the year axis.

options.label: Jackfield Schedule
options.case: Loses both: a tool interface, not a shop.
options.kept: One signal colour doing all the marking.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.viewport: Orange field with a frame rail.
options.case: Loses both: editing-room world, no shop resonance.
options.kept: State shown as a mark, not a colour.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.viewport: White cloud blocks with blue voids.
options.case: Loses both: dreamlike, unrelated to the shop.
options.kept: Deep gaps between sections as structure.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean premium toy-store page done impeccably, like the last version but at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline beside a large photo, season and category sections below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other store; you said this felt plain.
